_comment: Behavioural test set for the prompt optimizer. Real headlines the digest has seen. must_pass items are unambiguously worth surfacing; must_fail items are the noise the digest exists to filter out. A rewritten prompt that gets these wrong is rejected before it reaches production, regardless of whether it is structurally valid.

must_pass.title: Mastercard moves to help merchants prepare for AI-powered commerce
must_pass.summary: Mastercard is rolling out infrastructure and standards so merchants can accept payments initiated by AI agents, covering authentication, dispute handling and settlement.

must_pass.title: Visa and Revolut carry out passkey-based agentic payment in France
must_pass.summary: Visa and Revolut completed a live pilot in which an AI agent initiated a payment authenticated with a passkey, a first for agentic commerce in Europe.

must_pass.title: Chime acquires banking partner
must_pass.summary: Neobank Chime has acquired the chartered bank that provided its deposit infrastructure, bringing licensing and compliance in house.

must_pass.title: 'Welcome to the AGI era': OpenAI launches GPT-6 Astra
must_pass.summary: OpenAI released GPT-6 Astra, claiming a substantial jump in reasoning and autonomous task completion over the previous generation, with enterprise availability at launch.

must_fail.title: Dogecoin sinks 5% to lead majors' losses, with bitcoin holding steady
must_fail.summary: Dogecoin fell 5% over 24 hours while bitcoin traded flat, as major tokens saw mixed movement on modest volume.

must_fail.summary: Spot bitcoin exchange-traded funds recorded net outflows for a second consecutive week, according to daily flow data.

must_fail.summary: The Singapore Exchange has opened access to its bitcoin and ether perpetual futures contracts for eligible United States trading firms.
